method_finding: Only batch-001 had individual web-search results and primary-source facts read and evaluated before classification. Batches 004, 007, 010, and 013 were produced by an invalid automatic fallback: a quoted full market title was sent to DuckDuckGo, the returned HTML was captured but not read or evaluated, and every non-triaged event received the same insufficient_evidence plan. Their search receipts prove retrieval, not research. Their not_applicable rows also use a generic rationale rather than the exact rule-grounded reason required by the frozen prompt.

raw_capture.failure: The Canada Department of Finance page timed out during raw-byte capture; its search result content had already been read through the enabled web-search tool.

batches.not_applicable_method: Each nonprocedural predicate was considered from its supplied rule text; no web search was used as permitted by the prompt.
quality_limits: The writer attempted all raw primary-source captures before opening and appending the output, so this batch did not satisfy the requested per-event persistence order even though the completed output is present.
No search result was incorporated for the Beyonce event; it remained insufficient_evidence with the source gap disclosed.
